note: Absolute structural scores on different cards, not paired improvements or accuracy percentages. Reviewed held-out summaries exclude alignment flags; full coverage retains every eligible printing. Legacy layout/overflow is unmeasured. No per-card or target-set fitting.

alignment.scope: Mirage calibration copied unchanged to Tempest

profile.note: One frozen transform per frame family for this set. No per-scan fitting. Identity applies to uncalibrated families. Raw scores remain available.

review.evidence: Legacy retro-paint ignores rulesParagraphs styles and chooses 16/19/23px from character count. Reviewed flavor and reminder runs render upright. Use measured runs, fit, paragraph gaps and italic fonts, with old-border-specific geometry.

All 700 legacy captures lack measured layout. Clipping and soft-wrap accuracy are unknown; a zero clipped count is not a passed fit check. Add actual layout output and reviewed line targets before making spacing improvement claims.

Both inspected Forest printings show a written tap ability and type Land; the current Oracle adapter and retroBasicSymbol path produce a large mana emblem and modern Basic Land type. Track era-specific presentation separately from frame assets.

Seven nonbasic lands account for seven of eleven Mirage alignment flags. Grasslands is excluded from reviewed holdout aggregates; Bad River is a calibration residual flag. Investigate shared land-frame geometry before adding any set/family exception. Do not fit individual scans.

Existing seventh/regular b.png, g.png and gl.png frame bindings are below the review threshold in both sets. Mana cost regions and both set-symbol regions also flag. Region scores associate assets with error; glyph placement, geometry and co-occurring glyphs can cause the mismatch. No assets were replaced.

Title/type sizing and power/toughness placement need line-level review. The artist credit is centered by the legacy painter but left-aligned in inspected scans; legal/collector footer content is missing and excluded from typography aggregates. Printed body/type annotations do not certify these other regions.

timingScope: Warm runs are sequential Node comparisons of 350 cards at both tiers, including checksum verification with 350 cache hits. No Chromium, downloads or raster capture. Cold runs were concurrent with the other set and repository checks, so are not isolated performance benchmarks.
limitations: This is a baseline of the unchanged old-border painter, not a typography improvement or whole-card accuracy percentage. Twenty-four selected printed bodies were reviewed; 676 remaining Oracle bodies are diagnostic. One of sixteen holdouts is alignment-uncertain. The frame profile is specific to the tested seventh-family assets, not all historical frames.
